# `grow-apache-skywalking` (`grow_apache_skywalking`) — agent quickstart (Python)

Ships inside the wheel (`python -c "import grow_apache_skywalking, pathlib; print(pathlib.Path(grow_apache_skywalking.__file__).with_name('AGENTS.md').read_text())"`).
Docs: https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/apache-skywalking/ · Service: Apache SkyWalking · Categories: logging,tracing.

```sh
pip install grow-apache-skywalking
# PyPI may not carry it yet: pip install "grow-apache-skywalking @ git+https://github.com/grow-codes-packages/apache-skywalking@python-vX.Y.Z#subdirectory=python"
```

## Client

```python
from grow_apache_skywalking import SkyWalkingClient

# GROW_APACHE_SKYWALKING_* > vendor env > defaults (AsyncSkyWalkingClient has the same API)
client = SkyWalkingClient.from_env()
client.close()
```

Errors: `SkyWalkingError` subclasses (`ConfigError`, `AuthenticationError`, `NotFoundError`, …) with `code`,
`retryable`, `http_status`. Credentials are `Secret`; never log `reveal()` results.

## Logging: one call

```python
from grow_apache_skywalking import RequestLoggingMiddleware, init_logging

# after load_config(); configures the root logger
log = init_logging(service="orders")
# FastAPI/Starlette; WSGI: RequestLoggingWSGIMiddleware
app.add_middleware(RequestLoggingMiddleware)
log.info("started", extra={"port": 8000})
```

- `init_logging(service=None, level=None, stdout=True, *, ship=None, env=None, stream=None, redaction=None,
  connect=None) -> logging.Logger`; `flush_logging()`, `shutdown_logging()`, `send_canary(message, attrs)`,
  `logging_client()`, `request_id_var`.
- Always JSON lines on stdout (`time`, `level`, `msg`, `logger`, `service`, `environment`, `request_id`,
  `trace_id`, `span_id`, `extra=` fields, redacted). With `GROW_LOGGING_PROVIDER=apache-skywalking` it also ships
  through this package (`GROW_APACHE_SKYWALKING_*`), marks lines `log_shipped:"sdk"` and re-emits failed exports
  with `log_shipped:"sdk_failed"`. Never raises for a down logging service.
- Adapters: `LogHandler(client)`, `structlog_processor(client)`.
